title: Verify: anchorFor maths and PhaserHost layout reporting unit tests
summary: Unit tests for anchor maths and onLayout calls with Phaser mocked.
description: Test anchorFor with fixed inputs and PhaserHost onLayout with createGame, ResizeObserver and matchMedia faked.
acceptance_criteria: Anchor results match the formula for zoom, offset and DPR
onLayout fires on mount and on resize

steps.action: Add tests: (1) position (150,60), bounds {0,0,48,96}, scale 1, zoom 2, offset (10,20), dpr 1 expects top {x:358,y:140} and bottom {x:358,y:332}; (2) zoom 4 dpr 2 equals result (1); (3) bounds undefined returns null; (4) scale 2 doubles bounds offsets.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/anchor.test.ts

steps.action: Copy the mock setup (vi.mock createGame, fake ResizeObserver capturing its callback, jsdom) from frontend/tests/appObjectClick.test.tsx. Render PhaserHost with onLayout spy; assert one call with zoom>=1 and dpr 1 on mount; invoke the captured ResizeObserver callback and assert a second call.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/phaserHostLayout.test.tsx
steps.expected: onLayout called on mount and on resize
